description: Navigate to a URL in a hosted Chromium browser and return the page title and final URL after redirects. Creates a new browser session automatically if no session_id is provided. Use this as the first step in any browser automation workflow. Use stealth mode when visiting public websites that may block automated browsers. Use action_delay_ms to add human-like jitter between subsequent actions in the same session.

action_delay_ms.description: Random delay range in milliseconds between actions for human-like timing. Example: {"min": 500, "max": 1500}.

session_id.description: Reuse an existing browser session. Omit to auto-create a new session.

stealth.description: Enable stealth mode with a realistic user agent and hidden webdriver flag to reduce bot detection. Default: false.

url.description: Full URL to navigate to, including protocol (e.g. "https://example.com")

wait_until.description: Page lifecycle event to wait for. Default: "networkidle".

name: navigate
